decision_rules.P1: UNIT: row 2 (uncitral.un.org/en/commission, find 'A/81/17'). If ok/200 AND find_matched TRUE, the string 'A/81/17' occurred in the rendered text of UNCITRAL's own Commission Sessions page at that instant, and the returned window is the evidence of what it says there — the boolean alone establishes no publication, no date and no content. If find_matched is FALSE, the recorded fact is 'the string A/81/17 was not found in that page's rendered text at this instant' and NOTHING about whether the report exists, is published, or is imminent. That page returned find_matched false on 08-03, 08-04, 08-05, 08-06, 08-07, 08-09 and 08-10; a seventh false is a continuation of a null, not a finding. SCOPE: P1 only.
decision_rules.P2: UNIT: row 3 (treaty 978 mapping, find 'intellectual property'). NEVER ASKED BEFORE against this page. This targets limb (a) of the research question — whether IP appears in the UNCTAD mapping of the China-Switzerland BIT's investment definition. A match establishes that the phrase occurs in that page's rendered text and yields a window; ONLY the window's own text may be read, and it must not be reported as the treaty's own words — an UNCTAD mapping is UNCTAD's characterisation, not treaty text. If the row is refused/403, G5 governs: that is a fact about access, and the escalation asking the operator for the treaty text stands unchanged.
decision_rules.P3: UNIT: row 4 (treaty 978 mapping, find 'Denial of benefits'). NEVER ASKED BEFORE. This targets limb (c) — a live jurisdictional/admissibility doctrine, and the one most directly bearing on treaty-shopping. Same structure as P2: window-only, mapping-not-text, and a miss establishes only that the string was absent from that rendering at that instant. A 400-character window is presumed insufficient to establish the content of any treaty provision.
decision_rules.P4: UNIT: rows 3 and 4 jointly, ACCESS ONLY. If both return ok/200, this client's access to investmentpolicy.unctad.org was working at this instant, after two consecutive refused/403 runs on 08-10 and 08-11. If both return refused/403, the 403 condition persisted into a third observed run. Either way this is a finding about the ACCESS LAYER and is recorded as such; it founds nothing about the treaty, and per the standing rule it may not be restated anywhere as a claim about the resource.
